svg.title: ARMOR-VOICE-AI architecture
svg.desc: A wall panel and the Android assistant talk to ARMOR-SERVER. ARMOR-SERVER asks the voice service on the loopback address, which normalises the transcript, matches it against a closed list of commands in eight languages, issues signed single-use confirmations and applies the silence policy. An optional wake word detector and an optional Wyoming handler for Home Assistant are off by default. Speech engines are programs the installation chooses.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI','Noto Sans','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Yu Gothic','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif

svg.text: A spoken phrase becomes one of a closed list of commands, or nothing. It only decides; ARMOR-SERVER acts.
